hints.title: Sliding Window Framing
hints.text: For every candidate subarray of the fixed length, maximizing its sum using at most k swaps means swapping small elements inside the window with larger elements outside.

hints.title: Greedy Swap Selection
hints.text: Find up to k elements outside the window that are strictly greater than the smallest elements inside the window.

hints.title: Prefix and Sorting Optimization
hints.text: Maintain the current window sum and select the top positive differences between outside largest and inside smallest values.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sliding window with greedy swap replacement for fixed window size.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of k arbitrary index swaps is combinatorially explosive.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting inside and outside partition segments yields straightforward greedy swap evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that only elements strictly larger than inside elements are worth swapping.
